label: The Glass Orchard
summary: A quiet valley kingdom where orchard trees grow fruit of glass, and every fruit holds a memory.

world.setting: Tamsel Vale, an orchard valley ringed by mountains
world.description: Terraced orchards of glass-fruit trees, a market town on the river, a lord's house that has stood empty for a decade, and pickers who know which branches hum before a storm. Holding a ripe glass fruit lets you see the memory inside it.
rules: Gentle fantasy: magic is rare and lives in the glass fruit
A memory taken from a fruit cannot be put back
Romance develops slowly and only with mutual interest
